summary: NFT Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 600,000 units at $1.00 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and one five-year common warrant at a $1.00 exercise price, plus 400,000 pre-funded units at $0.96, each with a pre-funded warrant and one common warrant; purchasers subject to a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership cap. Shares trade on NYSE American under MI, last at $0.9046 on October 9, 2026, below the offering price. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms stated; this is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
